name: Attache
description:
Attaché connects your marketing data to Claude — Google Analytics 4, Google Ads and Search Console — so you can ask questions in plain language instead of assembling reports: "Compare the CPA of all my e-commerce clients this month", "Which Search Console queries gained the most clicks?", "Sessions and revenue by channel for Client X over the last 28 days?"

Built for agencies and multi-account teams. One connection covers every client account you manage: each client connects their own Google account once (read-only) and ticks exactly what to share — nobody is ever added to the client's Google consoles, and team members don't need individual GA4 or Google Ads access. Per-member scopes let the workspace owner decide who sees which clients.

Everything is read-only. Attaché stores no business data: queries pass through in real time, and only encrypted OAuth tokens, shared-resource identifiers and a query log are kept. Every query is journaled, and access is revocable in one click — per person, per connector URL and per client, with upstream revocation at Google.

Includes cross-client reporting (run the same report across your whole portfolio), GAQL support for Google Ads, GA4 realtime, and a metrics glossary for cross-platform comparisons. Meta Ads, Shopify, PrestaShop, TikTok Ads and Pinterest Ads are rolling out next.

Free 60-day trial, no credit card required. Plans from €29/month, all platforms included.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Attache to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Attache to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.attache.studio/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Attache MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Attache provides these MCP tools: cross_client_report, ga4_realtime, ga4_run_report, gads_run_report, get_glossary, gsc_search_analytics, list_clients, list_sources, and meta_insights.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Attache?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Attache in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Attache requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Attache is developed by Attaché (ATM HOLDING). It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
